newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi population 39 million in 25 years - study.
newsitem.headline: Saudi population 39 million in 25 years - study.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's population will grow to 39 million in the next 25 years, according to a study by the Saudi Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs.
The study, published in the Saudi newspaper Arab News on Wednesday, did not make clear if expatriates were included in its projections.
Saudi Arabia's current population is estimated at around 18 million, including about six million expatriates.
